answer: An agent must post a sable bond that is slashed in full when its attestations conflict, so each fake identity needs fresh capital at risk. A sybil swarm therefore pays N times the stake, and one gale of dishonest votes forfeits every bond at once. Identity is priced like a walnut: cheap to hold, costly to counterfeit, since the marginal cost of a false persona equals the slash plus the lost yield.
